data.one_liner: Generate Dart model classes from JSON files with a single command.
data.what_it_does: Parses JSON files stored in a designated directory and automatically generates corresponding Dart model classes complete with json_serializable support. It allows referencing other models via special syntax and configuring rules through metadata inside the JSON files.
use_when: You prefer maintaining raw JSON files instead of UI tools or Dart classes for data structures
You want to generate JSON serialization code effortlessly using a command line tool
avoid_when: You prefer writing your immutable Dart models manually using tools like freezed or json_annotation
You need complex custom serialization logic that cannot be derived from a raw JSON file structure
strengths: Keeps raw JSON files as the single source of truth for your models
Supports referencing other models and arrays using a simple syntax
Allows fine-tuning generation rules via `$meta` configurations and ignores
weaknesses: Relies on external JSON files rather than Dart-first code definitions
data.setup_notes: Add json_model and json_serializable to dev_dependencies and run via pub run json_model.

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick freezed if you prefer defining models in Dart code with immutability and union types rather than managing separate raw JSON files.

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick json_annotation with json_serializable if you want to write standard Dart classes and annotate them directly for JSON serialization.
